_doc: The LIS API + blob endpoints THIS product consumes. The endpoint audit (endpoint_audit.py) diffs the live LIS SPA bundle's route list against `consumed` + `acknowledged_ignore`; any LIS route in NEITHER is reported as parity drift (something on the state site we neither read nor have deliberately parked). Route keys are the `/<Area>/api/<method>` path, compared CASE-INSENSITIVELY (LIS ships mixed casing, e.g. getlegislationeventtypereferencesasync vs GetLegislationEventTypeReferencesAsync). Update `consumed` when the worker/tracker starts reading a new endpoint (that IS an output-affecting change — say so in the PR). Keep `acknowledged_ignore` reasons honest and specific.

consumed.purpose: bill status list (the product's status column)
structural per-bill event history (the §9 time-recovery classifier of record)
EventType reference (admin-recovery of date-drifted governor/conference rows)

acknowledged_ignore._doc: LIS routes we KNOW exist and deliberately don't consume, with the reason. Two buckets: (1) non-public write/admin/partner surfaces (LIS staff tools — never a lobbyist data source); (2) public-read endpoints we've evaluated and PARKED (each is a future-product candidate — cross-referenced to the idea page). A route matching the write/admin patterns below is auto-classified as bucket-1 and needs no explicit entry; list here only the public-read parks + anything the pattern misses.
